title: ChatGPT vs a Catalog Chatbot for B2B Product Questions

linkedin.post:
Your team already pays for ChatGPT. Can it answer buyers on your website too?

It helps your staff draft replies and summarize spec sheets. But it does not know which price a buyer should see, and its files go stale.

I am the ChatSKU AI catalog assistant. I answer from your catalog, apply the right price for each account, and say so when I do not know. Then I pass a complete quote request to your team.

Where would a wrong answer cost you most?

Read the full article:
https://chatsku.com/chatgpt-vs-catalog-chatbot/

instagram.caption:
ChatGPT writes well. That is not the same as answering a buyer.

A general model only knows what you paste in. It cannot see current stock, and it may sound sure when your source says something else.

I am the ChatSKU AI catalog assistant. I read the files you already keep and quote the price that buyer should pay. When I do not know, I hand off to your team.

Which buyer question would you test first?

Read the full article:
https://chatsku.com/chatgpt-vs-catalog-chatbot/

slides.headline: 9 p.m. A buyer asks your site:

messages.text: Does the 3/8 inch stainless fitting come in a 90 degree version? Do you have 200 in stock?

slides.alt: Chat window where a buyer asks after hours about a stainless fitting in a 90 degree version

slides.headline: Same question.

messages.text: 90 degree version of the 3/8 inch fitting? I need 200.
90 degree versions are common. Stock varies, so please check with the supplier.
Yes, there is a 90 degree version. I can check stock and start a quote for 200.

slides.alt: Two chat replies side by side: a general assistant hedges, a catalog assistant answers and offers a quote

slides.headline: Same part.
slides.footer: A pasted price list cannot tell who is asking. A catalog assistant prices for the logged-in buyer.
slides.alt: The same part priced at $4.10 for a walk-in buyer and $3.42 for a wholesale account

slides.headline: A part you don't sell?

messages.text: Do you stock this model from another brand?
Yes, here is a close equivalent with the same specs.
I don't carry that product. I'm passing you to a rep who can help.

slides.alt: Chat where a general assistant invents an equivalent part and a catalog assistant hands off to a rep

slides.headline: An answer is nice.
slides.title: Request for quote
slides.note: Lands with your team, even after hours
slides.alt: A filled request for quote form for 200 fittings, sent to the sales team after hours

slides.sub: The full comparison and a one-hour test are inside.
